# 查询账户余额 (USER\_DATA)

- **GET** `/capi/v3/account/balance`

权重(IP): 5

**请求参数**

NONE

**请求示例**

```
curl "https://api-contract.weex.com/capi/v3/account/balance" \
   -H "ACCESS-KEY:*******" \
   -H "ACCESS-SIGN:*******" \
   -H "ACCESS-PASSPHRASE:*****" \
   -H "ACCESS-TIMESTAMP:1659076670000" \
   -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

**返回参数**

| 参数名 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| asset | String | 资产名称 |
| balance | String | 总余额 |
| availableBalance | String | 可用余额 |
| frozen | String | 冻结资产 |
| unrealizePnl | String | 未实现盈亏 |

**返回示例**

```
[
  {
    "asset": "USDT",
    "balance": "5696.49288823",
    "availableBalance": "5413.06877369",
    "frozen": "81.28240000",
    "unrealizePnl": "-34.55300000"
  }
]
```
